# 📽️ Apple electrocution-bootanimation Apple electrocution bootanimation for google pixel. Only for pixel!!!!

## 📱 Tested device - Google Pixel 9a (Stock firmware) - Google Pixel 8a (Stock firmware) - Google Pixel 7a (LineageOS) ## 🚀Installation 1. Download the zip form [release](https://github.com/axy0n-qli/Apple-electrocution-bootanimation/releases/latest) 2. Download [Nomount](https://github.com/maxsteeel/nomount/releases/latest) zip 3. Open Magisk (or other root manager) 4. Install Nomount zip, reboot 5. Install the bootanimation and reboot ### 🤓 Building from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/axy0n-qli/Apple-electrocution-bootanimation cd Apple-electrocution-bootanimation make ``` ## 👨‍💻 Contribute? Contact me on Discord. See my profile. ## 📄 License This project is open-source and released under the **GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3)**. Feel free to modify and distribute it under the terms of the GPLv3 license. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for more details.

  • Google Pixel 7a (LineageOS)

    • 🚀Installation

    • 🤓 Building from source

cd Apple-electrocution-bootanimation
